title: Husband and Wife
definition: Husband and wife refers to the covenant relationship within marriage where both are called to love, honor, serve, and remain faithful to one another before God.
summary: Scripture calls husbands and wives to live together in love, humility, faithfulness, understanding, and mutual care. Marriage is strengthened when both seek Christ above selfishness.
christFocus: Christ's love for the Church shapes how husbands and wives are called to love, serve, forgive, and remain faithful.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture calls husbands and wives to live together in love, humility, faithfulness, understanding, and mutual care. Marriage is strengthened when both seek Christ above selfishness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
